projects.title: Shepherd's Heart
projects.description: Shepherd's Heart is an Xbox 360 compatible title created in 48 hours during the 2013 Global Game Jam.  In game the player acts as a piloted heart which must travel through space, blasting bug-like enemies, in order to re-animate the once evil boss into a love-able creature.

projects.title: Ana Gear the Cannoneer
projects.description: Ana Gear the Cannoneer was a side-scrolling 2.5D action platformer. It is physics based and forces the player to guide a young woman through a neighborhood, school, city, and underground laboratory to find and destroy the boss holding her cherished invention blueprints.
